items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: See when I had the band at the roof, Snoozer used to come up there and sit with us, whenever he was in town, you see.

ctx.x: I was wondering about Joe Coffero's style on guitar. Where did he get that?

That's, as far as I, I didn't know any, anybody. Well he did, some things he took off Snoozer. Yeah. Cause he and Snoozer were good friends. See when I had the band at the roof, Snoozer used to come up there and sit with us, whenever he was in town, you see. He'd come up there and sit there with us and play guitar and fiddle, you know. That scratchy fiddle. You ever hear him play fiddle? Never did. Oh man, you ain't heard nothing. You ain't like they say, you ain't heard nothing until you heard Snoozer play fiddle.
Was it good or is it funny?
